field.label: Enable Search
field.comment: Enables NeuronaptiQ search in the search field (suggest).

field.label: Enable Cross-Sellings
field.comment: Fills the "Related Products" block of the product page with NeuronaptiQ cross-sellings. Falls back to the maintained related products if the API is not available or returns no results.

field.label: Cross-Selling Limit
field.comment: Number of cross-selling products in the "Related Products" block of the product page (1-20).

field.label: Send Customer Data
field.comment: Sends the data of logged-in customers (name, email, birth year, address country, ...) to NeuronaptiQ. Requires a legal basis (privacy policy, data processing agreement). Search result pages of logged-in customers are then excluded from the full page cache.

field.label: Enable Tracking
field.comment: Sends cart changes, checkout visits, orders and customer logins (only if sending customer data is enabled) to NeuronaptiQ.

field.label: Environment
field.comment: Possible values: Development (dev), Testing (test) or Production (prod).

field.label: Instance Name
field.comment: The name of the NeuronaptiQ instance (e.g. {name}.synapse.neuronaptiq.ai).

field.label: Suggest Limit
field.comment: Maximum number of suggested products in the search field.

field.label: Enhanced Search Suggestions
field.comment: Shows product image and price in the search suggestions and opens the product page directly when a suggestion is selected (with the matching variant preselected). If disabled, the default Magento behavior is used: the suggestion text is searched.

field.label: Suggest Parent Products Instead of Variants
field.comment: Shows a matching variant as its parent product in the search suggestions (name, image and "as low as" price of the parent; the link keeps the variant preselection). Intended for the variant setting "Best variant" of the NeuronaptiQ integration, which returns one variant per parent product. The search result page always shows parent products.

field.label: Separate Log File
field.comment: Writes the log messages of the module to var/log/neuronaptiq.log (API requests and responses only with debug logging enabled). Disable it to log via the Magento logger (system.log, debug.log), e.g. on cloud setups that forward the Magento logs to a central log service.
